_comment: The anchor transaction that ACTUALLY EXECUTED on Monad mainnet, fetched from chain rather than constructed. Its calldata carries the SHA-256 and execution commitment of outputs/signed_orders.json; verify with verify_claims.py --chain, or decode the fields below by hand. Replaced 2026-08-30: the previous anchor (0x34e79cbf…2a65, seq 4, orderHash 0x8fdc0057…d3de) bound an order whose deadline 1788298709 expired 2026-09-01, and the vault checks the deadline BEFORE the commitment, so both arms of the tamper-evidence replay would have collapsed into the same DeadlinePassed revert. This one binds an order valid to 2031-12-31. The superseded artefacts are kept in outputs/archive/.

decoded.function: anchor(bytes32 orderHash, bytes32 execCommitment, uint64 seq)
